name: AI Content Automation Tool
description: A free and open-source AI-powered tool that automates the creation of YouTube content by writing video scripts, generating voiceovers, producing videos, and uploading them automatically, enabling hands-free YouTube channel growth.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: The subject or theme for which the video content will be generated.

inputs.name: script_parameters
inputs.description: Parameters to control script generation, such as script length, style, or tone.

inputs.name: voiceover_settings
inputs.description: Settings that specify voice preferences for the generated voiceover (e.g., language, gender, pitch).

inputs.name: video_assets
inputs.description: Optional collection of images, clips, or templates to be used in video creation.

inputs.name: upload_credentials
inputs.description: Authentication tokens or credentials for uploading the generated video to YouTube.

outputs.name: script
outputs.description: The generated script text for the YouTube video.

outputs.name: voiceover_audio
outputs.description: The AI-generated voiceover audio based on the script.

outputs.name: video_file
outputs.description: The final video assembled with voiceover and visual assets.

outputs.name: upload_status
outputs.description: Confirmation or error message indicating the success or failure of the video upload to YouTube.

patterns: End-to-end automation pipeline for content creation
AI-driven script writing from topic input
Automatic video assembly from scripts and media assets
Automated upload to video sharing platform using API
steps: Receive topic and configuration inputs for video creation
Generate video script text using AI language models
Convert the script text into natural-sounding voiceover audio
Combine voiceover with videos and image assets to produce a video file
Authenticate and upload the generated video to YouTube automatically
use_cases: YouTubers seeking to automate repetitive content production
Content creators needing hands-free video generation at scale
Marketing teams automating video ads or promotional content
Educators creating automated lecture or tutorial videos
Small businesses generating video content without dedicated production resources

prompt_templates.name: script_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Write a comprehensive and engaging YouTube video script about {topic} in a {tone} tone.

prompt_templates.name: voiceover_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a clear and natural voiceover audio reading the following script: {script}

prompt_templates.name: video_description_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Create a video description for a YouTube video about {topic} to maximize viewer engagement.
